_comment: Dashboard classification inventory for registered event types. Each event is classified by its relationship to the browser observability frontend. Classification is based on actual production emission paths, not on constant registration alone. Updated when producers or payloads change.

_classification_legend.produced_to_sse: A real production path emits this event through the SSE push endpoint with a typed payload. Browser consumers can observe it on the live stream.
_classification_legend.governed_record_only: The event is a governed document mutation or audit record. It is persisted but not emitted as a browser telemetry event. Dashboard state derives from projections, not from these events directly.
_classification_legend.dashboard_safe: The event carries a protocol-owned typed payload suitable for direct browser rendering in the live narrative stream. Restricted content is redacted or summarized by the event presentation registry.
_classification_legend.unsupported: The event is registered but has no real producer, no protocol-owned payload schema, or contains content unsuitable for browser display. It remains inspectable in diagnostic views but never updates derived dashboard state.

_note: The four observability dashboard events (app.agent.status.updated, app.run.status.updated, ai.eval.run.completed, ai.eval.metric.recorded) are dashboard_safe by definition once their producers land. Until producers are wired in Phase 3, they are classified as unsupported.

g8e.v1.ai.agent.description: Agent conflict and continue-approval events. Emitted by the ensemble during multi-agent coordination. Safe for narrative display as non-actionable notices.

g8e.v1.ai.consensus.description: Consensus session, voting, and audit events. Emitted by the consensus service. Safe for narrative display; approvals shown as non-actionable notices.

g8e.v1.ai.eval.description: ai.eval.run.completed and ai.eval.metric.recorded are registered with protocol-owned payloads but have no real producer until Phase 3 wires the eval publication path. Classified unsupported until producers land.

g8e.v1.ai.llm.description: Chat iteration, tool lifecycle, and LLM lifecycle events. Emitted by the ensemble. Safe for narrative display with phase labels; thinking payloads shown as phase summaries, not chain-of-thought.

g8e.v1.ai.reputation.description: Reputation state updates. Emitted by the reputation service. Safe for narrative display.

g8e.v1.ai.triage.description: Triage clarification events. Emitted by the triage agent. Safe for narrative display.

g8e.v1.app.agent.description: app.agent.activity.recorded is a governed document update for AgentActivityMetadata (governed_record_only). app.agent.status.updated is a dashboard_safe event with a protocol-owned payload but is unsupported until its producer lands in Phase 3.

g8e.v1.app.run.description: app.run.status.updated is registered with a protocol-owned payload but has no real producer until Phase 3 wires the run state projection path. Classified unsupported until producers land.
